objective: Implement configured detached signature verification for release approval and bind authorized approver, decision, commit, and artifact to an operator-managed public-key trust store.
acceptance: Offline signature verifies with trusted allowlisted public key and is bound to approval payload, candidate commit, artifact digest, invocation, identity, decision, and authority reference
Unsigned, altered, unauthorized, stale, or unverifiable approvals fail closed
Trust store rejects symlink, non-regular, oversized, and group/world-writable files
Operator CLI exposes canonical approval payload generation and release-check trust store option
Full repository tests and validators pass; candidate zipapp is rebuilt and hashed
Independent code/security review and GitHub CI validate the exact committed tree
